overview: Woodworker’s Lane is home to Katta’s carpenters and timberwrights, producing furniture, structural supports, ceremonial carvings, and arcane‑reinforced woodcraft.
history: Founded to centralize carpentry and fine‑woodcraft production.
Terraced workshops were built to support large timber projects.
The district expanded to support Stonecarver’s Rise and Artisan Row.
hooks: A ceremonial carving order for the Senate is behind schedule.
A timber shipment goes missing from the storage yard.
Arcane saws malfunction across the district.
A terrace support beam destabilizes, threatening collapse.
